news.aiSummary: The article uses a simulated salary survey to demonstrate how Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) can underestimate effects, shrinking a $5,000 impact to $3,200. It then shows how to recover the true effect by implementing Tobit and truncated likelihood models from scratch in Python.
